Sanjay Matai's hospitality work has combined Miami nightlife with guest services. As VIP director at Mr Jones, he represented the venue to guests while it operated within the city's club market. The role placed him on the guest-facing side of nightlife operations.

Matai also pursued service businesses outside nightlife. He led Casanova Concierge, a Florida company formed in 2018, and worked in local real-estate sales.
